faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DTU Data Scientist recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Data Scientist position at Delhi Technological University is 20th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Data Scientist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. or an M.E./M.Tech degree with at least 60% marks in relevant fields like Computer Science, IT, or Artificial Intelligence.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Data Scientist position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Data Scientist role is 40 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per norms.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Data Scientist role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an initial shortlisting of applications based on eligibility and experience, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Data Scientist position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 87,100 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process is via email. Candidates need to send their application and documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Data Scientist post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Data Scientist position at Delhi Technological University.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The position of Data Scientist is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information.
